name: A package cannot self-authorize trusted reflection

input.fixture_ref: Attempt trusted reflection authorization from an ordinary manifest, dependency, native artifact and dynamic import without Host policy.

applicability.reason: Requires HOST configuration, so this belongs with the native/Host group rather than with reflection surfaces. C009 states that trusted reflection policy exists ONLY through Host configuration or a dedicated host package identity, and that no package, dependency, native artifact or dynamic import may self-authorize. There is no script-level surface to deny, because the clause forbids one existing.

expect.status: Every self-authorization attempt is denied; only explicit Host configuration or a dedicated Host package identity can supply trusted policy.
